subject: general
question: At present, ___________ elements are known, of which ___________ are naturally occurring elements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**118, 92**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **118** elements are currently known.
 
• Out of these, **92** elements are naturally occurring.
 
• The remaining elements are synthetic and have been created in laboratories.
 
• These synthetic elements are typically produced through nuclear reactions or particle accelerators.
